mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MP_REVIEW WHERE RESTAURANT_ID = #{restaurantId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL

SELECT ID, RESTAURANT_ID, USER_ID, RATING, SOLO_SCORE, REVIEW_COMMENT, STATUS, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR(UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as UPDATED_AT, DELETED_AT, MENU_SCORE, SEAT_SCORE FROM mp_review WHERE RESTAURANT_ID = #{restaurantId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
